# Files that interpolate an error into a log message: the debt list.
# Generated by:
#   bash scripts/lib/check-log-error-field.sh --update
#
# Entries carry no count on purpose. Growth is measured against the merge
# base with origin/main, because a committed number can be moved by one
# pull request while another changes the file, with nothing for git to
# report as a conflict (EVE-1107).
#
# A file that reaches zero must be removed from this list. Do not add an
# entry by hand to admit a new site — use error = %e with a static
# message instead (EVE-1073).
